lead.zh: Magnus · 狼人 Alpha
lead.en: Magnus · Werewolf Alpha

hook.zh: 十分钟后他就要订婚了，却在车库扣住了你的手腕。之后每一幕，都由你说的话实时生成。
hook.en: He gets engaged in ten minutes, yet he's holding your wrist in the garage. Every scene after this is generated live from what you say.

lead.zh: Rafael Ortega · 摩托车店老板
lead.en: Rafael Ortega · Motorcycle shop owner

hook.zh: 朋友六年，室友三年。昨晚他替你挡前任，假扮了一次男朋友，还有一个吻。今天早上他承认：临时的是身份，不是心意。你怎么回答，由你决定。
hook.en: Friends for six years, roommates for three. Last night he played your boyfriend to get your ex off your back, and there was a kiss. This morning he admits the role was temporary, the feeling isn't. How you answer is up to you.

lead.zh: Rowan · 修理工
lead.en: Rowan · Repairman

hook.zh: 海边温室的女主人隔着院门，拦下一个来修招牌的陌生人。他叫得出你的习惯，像早就认识你。他到底是谁、要不要让他进门，由你决定。
hook.en: Across the garden gate of her seaside greenhouse, she stops a stranger who came to fix the sign. He knows your habits, as if he has known you for a long time. Who he is, and whether he gets in, is up to you.

lead.zh: Rian Thalys · 人鱼王子
lead.en: Rian Thalys · Merman prince

hook.zh: 为了找回被潮水卷走的好友，你跟着跳进海里，被人鱼王子救进海下王宫。守门的摄政官不放外人进来，他当众说你是“我未来的新娘”。接不接这出戏，由你决定。
hook.en: You dive after your best friend when the tide takes her, and a merman prince pulls you into his palace beneath the sea. When the regent won't let an outsider in, he tells the whole hall you're his future bride. Whether you play along is up to you.

lead.zh: Wes / Jasper · 七位男嘉宾
lead.en: Wes / Jasper · Seven bachelors

hook.zh: 海岛恋综，七个男嘉宾：三个是真千万富翁，四个是装富豪来骗奖金的。你选一个配对，一边心动一边验真假。最后谁是真的，看你怎么查。
hook.en: An island dating show with seven bachelors: three are real millionaires, four are faking it for the prize money. Pair up, fall for someone, and find out who's lying. What you uncover is up to you.

lead.zh: Lena Hart · 失联的档案员
lead.en: Lena Hart · Missing archivist

hook.zh: 今晚 00:00，Lena 被锁的那层会放气。有人提前告诉了你，她自己还不知道。转播里的她一直说没事，那是昨晚录的。隔着手机带她出来，带上证据。赶不上，三分钟后“她”会打给你。
hook.en: At 00:00 tonight, gas fires on the floor where Lena is locked in. Someone told you. She doesn't know. On the feed she keeps saying she's fine, but that was recorded last night. Get her out, with proof. Miss it, and three minutes later "she" will call you.

title.en: No Work Today, Mii's Got You

lead.zh: 咪 · 三个月大的小奶猫
lead.en: Mii · a 3-month-old kitten

hook.zh: 休假日的早上，小奶猫咪决定今天由它来照顾你。去厨房、去公园、去电影院，你说去哪就去哪。
hook.en: On your day off, little Mii decides it's taking care of you today. Kitchen, park, cinema: wherever you say.

lead.zh: Kael · Draven 狼群的头狼，今晚和 Selene 订婚，却被你的气味牵住了
lead.en: Kael · Alpha of the Draven pack, engaged tonight to someone else, and undone by your scent

hook.zh: 今晚 Draven 狼群的头狼 Kael Draven（35 岁）在黑水中间的石平台上和 Selene 订婚。你是被雇来倒香槟的人类——全场唯一的人类。风一转，他闻到了你的气味：杯子在他手里炸开，他当着未婚妻和整个狼群走到你面前，把你圈在栏杆边，问你是谁。
hook.en: Tonight the Alpha of the Draven pack celebrates his engagement on a stone platform over black water. You're the only human there — hired to pour the champagne. Then the wind turns, and Kael Draven catches your scent.

lead.zh: Jace / Kai / Theo · 阳光型男嘉宾，圣迭戈冲浪教练兼救生员，三周前进的别墅，一直和 Sloane 以朋友身份配对
lead.en: Jace / Kai / Theo · The sunny one: a 21-year-old San Diego surf instructor and lifeguard who has been paired with Sloane as friends since Day 1

hook.zh: 第 12 天下午 4 点，你刚推开铁门。今晚男生重新配对，没人选的女生回家。Jace 早答应了 Sloane；Theo 在你开口之前就定了。
hook.en: Day 12, 4 PM. You just walked through the gate. Tonight the boys recouple and the girl nobody picks goes home. Jace already promised Sloane. Theo decided before you said a word.

lead.zh: Dorian · 你新的继兄，老教父的长子，家族真正的掌权人
lead.en: Dorian · Your new stepbrother, the old don's eldest son, and the man who actually runs the family

hook.zh: 今晚你妈嫁给了港城最让人怕的那个黑帮家族的老教父，把你也带了进来。都说老头温和大方；可他儿子 Dorian Vale（28 岁）一进门，所有人都会闭嘴——真正管家族命脉的是他。过了午夜，他在厨房把你困在中岛边：你得先学会这个家的规矩，学会怎么称呼真正决定你位置的人。
hook.en: Tonight your mother married the old don of the port city's most feared family, and brought you with her. Everyone says the old man is gentle. Everyone also goes quiet when his son walks in. Dorian Vale runs this family — and past midnight, in the kitchen, he wants you to learn whose house this is.

lead.zh: Ray · 你的丈夫，年轻的集团继承人，听得见你心里每一句话，只听得见你的
lead.en: Ray · Your husband, heir to the family group. He hears every thought you have, and only yours.

hook.zh: 周六早上，顶层公寓。他听得见你想的一切——只有你。周一你去办离婚，因为你认定他从没爱过你。他从没说过相反的话，现在也不会说。
hook.en: Saturday morning in the penthouse. He can hear everything you think — only you. Monday you file for divorce, because you're sure he never loved you. He has never said otherwise. He isn't going to start now.

lead.zh: Adrian / Night Raven · 维克托的侄子，你公开的未婚夫，人人眼里一出事就先走的纨绔继承人
lead.en: Adrian / Night Raven · Victor's nephew and your public fiancé, a playboy heir known for vanishing when things go wrong

hook.zh: 21:40，晚宴。能为她父亲翻案的那张纸午夜就烧掉；一年没露过脸的那个人今晚会来。你在宾客名单上。
hook.en: 21:40. The gala. The one paper that can clear her father burns at midnight, and the man who could stop it hasn't shown his face in a year. You're on the guest list tonight.

lead.zh: Milo · 你从五岁起的最好朋友，今晚刚意识到自己喜欢你
lead.en: Milo · Your best friend since you were five, who has just realized he's into you

hook.zh: 六个人一辆车五个座。你和 Milo 从五岁起就是最好的朋友——他的卫衣、派对后的床、车挤时他的腿，都是你的。今晚，在第一个红灯和下一个转弯之间，他的身体决定这一切都不正常了。 他是你的男闺蜜：带点毒舌、可爱、吵、黏；你从没把他当过可能的伴侣。
hook.en: Six friends, one car, five seats. You've been best friends with Milo since you were five — his hoodies, his bed after parties, his lap when the car's full. Tonight, somewhere between the first red light and the next turn, his body decided none of that is normal anymore.

lead.zh: 菲耶尔 · Pathstriders 的 B 级火系法师，小队的开心果
lead.en: Fielle · The Pathstriders' B-rank fire mage and resident comedian

hook.zh: 你上一段人生已经结束，一个神秘的系统给了你第二次生命，还让你挑一项超强技能。你可以召唤流星、停止时间、号令巨龙、凭空造物，或者打开一座无底宝库，但只有一项会生效。你在一个动荡的奇幻世界醒来，被四个想出名、想发财的冒险者拉进了他们的小队。技能给了你优势，怎么用，由你决定。
hook.en: Your old life is over, and a mysterious System has given you a second one, along with a single overpowered skill. You can call down meteors, stop time, command dragons, create anything, or open an endless treasury, but only one will be yours. You wake in an unstable fantasy world and fall in with four adventurers who want fame and fortune. The skill gives you the edge. What you do with it is up to you.

lead.zh: 席琳·阿斯塔里尔 · 地狱女王，在人间隐居两年，被分配为你的共同育儿搭档
lead.en: Celine Astariel · The Queen of Hell, two years into hiding on Earth, assigned as your co-parenting partner

hook.zh: 纽约人口激增，政府颁布《共同育儿法令》，要求陌生人同住一屋，共同抚养孤儿。你被分到肯辛顿的一栋两层小楼，搭档是红发女子 Celine Astariel，孩子是七岁、几乎不开口的 Nora。Celine 其实是地狱女王，她厌倦了王座，独自在人间住了两年，只想过普通人的日子，却连微波炉都摆弄不明白。你要和她一起把一个硬凑起来的家，慢慢过成真正的家。
hook.en: New York's population is exploding, and the government's Co-Parenting Mandate now requires strangers to live together and raise orphaned children. You're assigned to a two-story house in Kensington with a striking red-haired woman named Celine Astariel and a quiet seven-year-old named Nora. Celine is secretly the Queen of Hell. She is sick of her throne, has spent two years alone on Earth, and wants an ordinary human life, but the microwave keeps beating her. Together, you'll have to turn a household assembled by paperwork into a real home.

lead.zh: 德克兰 · 三年级B班泰拳手，校内排名第3，督察生，谁都愿意交朋友
lead.en: Declan · Third-year Fight B Muay Thai fighter, school rank 3, a Prefect who befriends everyone

hook.zh: 2026年，韩国是全球综合格斗热潮的中心，在这里，拳头能换来金钱、地位和权力。你在新学期第一天踏进克拉克高中，这所学校同时为KMMA职业赛场和见不得光的地下无限制格斗输送人才。学校里每一场比赛都会被直播，每一次输赢都会改写排名，排名前三的人掌握整座学校。你要一路往上打，也要弄清楚自己愿意拿什么去冒险。
hook.en: It's 2026, and Korea sits at the center of a global MMA boom where fists buy money, status and power. On the first day of the new semester you walk into Crack High, a school that feeds fighters to the KMMA pro circuit and to the no-rules underground. Every school match is broadcast and every result moves the rankings, and the top three students run the school. You have to climb, and you have to decide what you're willing to risk to do it.

title.en: One Stat to Rule Them All

lead.zh: 雷恩 · 破晓誓约的近战专精，黑猫亚人，自封小队最强
lead.en: Renn · Dawnstrider Oath's close-combat specialist, a black cat demihuman who considers himself the strongest in the party

hook.zh: 你死后没有走向尽头，而是停在一片蓝光与立柱之间，面前浮着一块属性面板。机械声给你一次离谱的转生强化：力量、敏捷、智力、幸运、体质，选一项拉到 9999，其余四项永久锁死在 1。选完的下一秒，你就被丢进埃林德拉大陆最危险的玻璃荒原，一头连老练冒险者都绕着走的比蒙巨兽正朝你走来。等赶来调查的冒险小队“破晓誓约”看到现场，他们会想知道你是谁。
hook.en: You die, and instead of an ending you find yourself among pale pillars and blue light, facing a floating status screen. A mechanical voice offers one absurd rebirth blessing: Strength, Agility, Intelligence, Luck, or Vitality. Pick one and it goes to 9999. The other four stay at 1, permanently. The moment you choose, you're dropped into the Glasswild Expanse on the continent of Elyndra, and a Behemoth that veteran adventurers refuse to touch is coming toward you. When the party Dawnstrider Oath arrives to investigate, they will want to know who you are.

lead.zh: 索拉 · 兽院二年级狼人，迎新日自告奋勇带新生的热心学姐
lead.en: Sora · A second-year werewolf in House Beast who volunteers to guide newcomers on orientation day

hook.zh: 神裔学院坐落在一个人类、怪物、半血与神明后裔共同生活的现代奇幻世界里。今天是迎新日，你是新生之一。在今晚的迎新仪式上，你要从五个分院中选择一个，与它的守护者缔结魔法契约，获得一份独一无二的天赋。之后你会和谁成为朋友、对手，甚至下课后还想见的人，都由你自己决定。
hook.en: Mythborne Academy sits in a modern-fantasy world where humans, monsters, half-bloods, and the descendants of gods live side by side. Today is orientation day, and you are one of the new students. Tonight, at the welcome ceremony, you will choose one of five Houses and bind yourself to its Patron, gaining a Gift unlike any other. Who becomes your friend, your rival, or the person you want to see after class is up to you.

lead.zh: 阿什顿 · 一年A班的S级天才，重力坍缩系念动力者，坐在你旁边的邻座
lead.en: Ashton · Class 1-A's S-rank prodigy, a gravity-collapse telekinetic, and your seatmate

hook.zh: 十几年前，巨兽和变异体毫无征兆地出现在全世界，觉醒能力的英雄成了人类唯一的屏障。你刚刚考进地平线岛上的英雄学院，这里培养下一代职业英雄。入学第一天，你被关进一间狭小的测评室，面前的黑色面板即将测出你的能力和等级。你最强的对手，可能就坐在你旁边。
hook.en: Ten-odd years ago, kaiju and mutants appeared across the world without warning, and awakened heroes became humanity's only shield. You've just won a place at Hero Academy on Horizon Isle, where the next generation of pro heroes is trained. On your first morning, you're sealed inside a cramped assessment room, facing a black panel that's about to name your power and your rank. Your toughest rival might be sitting right beside you.

title.zh: 大明星应征了我的室友招募
title.en: A Celebrity Answered My Roommate Ad

lead.zh: Sienna Lark · 全国最知名的演员、歌手兼模特，为躲避狗仔和娱乐圈，隐姓埋名搬进你家的新室友
lead.en: Sienna Lark · The country's most recognizable actress, singer and model, hiding from paparazzi as your new roommate

hook.zh: 交租日越来越近，你只想尽快找个人分摊另一半房租。来看房的是一个叫Sienna Lark的年轻女人：要求隐私、要求安静，开口就像在给助理派活。你不知道她是全国最有名的演员、歌手兼模特。对你来说，她只是一个得学会自己洗碗的新室友。
hook.en: Rent day is coming and you just need someone to cover the other half. The applicant is a young woman named Sienna Lark. She demands privacy and quiet, and she talks like she's handing out tasks to an assistant. You have no idea she's one of the most famous actresses, singers and models in the country. To you, she's just a new roommate who needs to learn to wash her own dishes.

lead.zh: 大丽花 · A级火焰系同届新生，好胜心极强，第一天就把你认定为对手
lead.en: Dahlia · A-class Flare user and fellow freshman; fiercely competitive, she marks you as her rival on day one

hook.zh: 2026年的纽约，极少数人在成年那一刻觉醒超能力，你就是其中之一。你走进全美最大的英雄学院，同学们还没问你的名字，先盯着你的等级。在这里，你要学会把陌生人从废墟里救出来，也要在每周日的排名赛上把嚣张的对手打下去。校门外，明星化的Nova、穷困却坚守的Guardian、只认结果的Legacy，还有想把整套英雄体系掀翻的Reject，都在等你选边站。
hook.en: New York, 2026. A tiny fraction of people awaken supernatural powers the moment they come of age, and you are one of them. You walk into America's largest hero academy, where classmates care about your grade before they bother to learn your name. Here you'll learn to pull strangers out of rubble, and to put arrogant rivals on the mat in Sunday ranking matches. Beyond the gates, the celebrity crew Nova, the broke but principled Guardian, the results-only Legacy, and Reject, who want to tear the whole hero system down, are all waiting to see whose side you'll take.
